topology_method: Volatile per-board ingress/egress frame filters if natural isolation is unavailable; not a physical RF isolation measurement.
filter_restrictions: One local allow-list sent only to each board, affects HELLO and all control/data frames equally.
No routes, gateway weights, next hops, full graph or preferred relay sent to routing firmware.
MACs for filter construction come from current verified device identities; actual neighbor/cache state begins empty.
Filter configuration is saved as experimental evidence, and is cleared for deployment.
ownership: Four independent processes, each with exactly one local serial owner and its own application/event log. Supervisor coordinates fault injection and reads logs, never forwards RF payload or selects/installs routes.
phases: Fresh service/lease/current MAC checks and retain exact per-board existing app/whole-flash backup references.
Integrate only frozen E1 contract/core into an isolated H snapshot if necessary; otherwise consume formally released compatible target without rebuilding unchanged code.
Deploy same protocol to A/B/C/D under H015 exclusive physical window; per local board configure group/channel/autostart only, plus explicitly labelled temporary local test filter.
Read actual confirmed neighbor tables for the diamond, confirm no remote routes preinstalled; do not use a host planner.
Source application sends an original 160-byte payload to C; record request/candidates/selected path, per-hop same-identity events and C application bytes.
Optionally one distinct second baseline payload checks cache behavior, not a resend.
Determine which relay the board actually used from its original selected-path/data events; command only that relay to stop RF and verify it stopped.

Submit bounded distinct new source messages; preserve unknown/lost outcomes, do not resend an old identity or payload automatically. Require actual invalidation and new discovery evidence before claiming rediscovery.
Verify subsequent new delivery through the other relay without host route commands; record local counters and board processing/memory fields, leaving unavailable metrics null.
Stop/drain/close every board, clear temporary filters and explicitly record each saved mode/autostart state; preserve rollback and a user-repeatable start/clear/deploy entry.
measurements: Original origin/boot/seq/dst and byte hashes at source and C application
Actual request/reply/selected path and whether both candidates arrived in W
First-build and fault-recovery host-observed times, with device clocks stored separately
Per-kind generated/core-output/radio-submitted/link-result/received control and data counters where exposed
On-device heap/high-water and route-processing timing only if actually instrumented
limitations: Controlled logical topology is distinct from natural RF isolation.
Same-PC four independent processes is not four physical Ubuntu hosts.
Full-MAC lexical ordering may prefer D over B for these actual board addresses; the supervisor must withdraw whichever relay was actually selected.
No physical RF retries/airtime/one-way latency inferred from serial callbacks.
Delivered means C original bytes; source acceptance, candidates and TX success alone are not delivery.
